articles.title: England crush France to remain in hunt for World Cup semi-final spot
articles.summary: England kept alive their faint hopes of reaching the Rugby League World Cup semi-finals with an 82-0 trouncing of France.

articles.title: 'Like a mini World Cup' - Jacks sees positives in England's tri-series troubles
articles.summary: Will Jacks intends to treat England's next two tri-series matches as a mini World Cup after defeats by Pakistan and Sri Lanka in their opening two matches boxed them into must-win territory.

articles.title: What do England need to avoid historic early World Cup exit?
articles.summary: England kept their slim Rugby League World Cup hopes alive with victory over France, but what do Brian McDermott’s side still need to reach the semi-finals?
